name: KGDmnDecision
title: Knowledge graph L2-DMN: DMN Decision
description: A `dmn:decision` -- the question being answered, and the node that carries the link back to the BPMN task invoking it. A file may hold several; the BCG file holds one. Class IRI: http://smart.who.int/kg/dmn-decision.

element.definition: A `dmn:decision` -- the question being answered, and the node that carries the link back to the BPMN task invoking it. A file may hold several; the BCG file holds one. Class IRI: http://smart.who.int/kg/dmn-decision.
The identifier the source declares (an FSH instance id, a BPMN or DMN element id).
The decision's question, as the DMN states it.
The decision's allowed answers, as the DMN states them.
